svg.desc: QQQ H3 retrospective in-sample trade map 2000-01-03 through 2026-07-13. Seven panels show historical weekly adjusted candles. Markers show actual next-open simulated trades, followed by the 58-trade ledger and one still-open position. No future data is used for signal decisions.
svg.text: QQQ EMA V3.1-H3 | Seven weekly K panels + all 58 executed trades
2000-01-03 to 2026-07-13 | $100k initial | 0.05% per side | close signals → next regular open fills
End $1,323,429 / CAGR 10.23% / MDD -24.30% / Payoff 5.39 / 25 wins, 33 losses
H3 monthly-negative-acceleration FAST: 21 closed trades (of 58); 1 additional open H3 FAST as of cutoff | Research-only / NOT live orders
Complete H3 execution ledger | 58 closed trades + 1 open position
Actual adjusted next-open fills; simulated round-trip fees included in net returns. H3 extra FAST rows in green. Reproduce from linked derived CSV.

svg.text: H3 is a research-only in-sample variant, NOT a selected or live strategy. Weekly candles show context; all entry/exit signals use completed DAILY bars.
58 closed trades, one open on 2026-07-13; final equity includes open-position mark-to-market. Do not mix with selected V3's 2026-11-09 snapshot.
Close-triggered 7% / Day0 -3% guards execute NEXT open; overnight gaps can exceed thresholds. No tax, opening slippage, or cash interest modeled.
